The main takeaway from our work is that

a well-posed direct-sum boundary integral formulation can achieve high accuracy and fast convergence with only a small amount of device memory, which is a very desirable property for a GPU implementation of PB solvers.
the boundary integral formulation is well-suited for GPU acceleration and can achieve significant speedup over the CPU implementation.
, with proper parallelization, the boundary element method can be made to run very fast on GPU.
